title: gluta curtisii
intro: Gluta curtisii, commonly known as the Philippine ironwood, is a species of tree native to the Philippines. This plant is rich in health benefits, including its ability to support cardiovascular health, boost the immune system, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Gluta curtisii include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, making it a potential treatment for various diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include tannins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
